exams.name: Written examination (medical competence)
exams.notes: Applicant must attain at least 75% correct answers. Maximum of two subsequent examinations (3 total attempts) after initial failure. Must pass all parts within 7 years (10 years for dual MD-PhD). Board-certified by American Board of Medical Specialties may waive 7-year requirement.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners)
exams.quote: The examination required by this chapter shall be in writing... Each applicant shall be required to attain an average percentage of at least seventy-five percent of correct answers. Any applicant failing on such examination is eligible for a maximum of two subsequent examinations

exams.name: USMLE or COMLEX-USA (for Interstate Medical Licensure Compact expedited license)
exams.notes: Required for eligibility for expedited license through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact. Each component must be passed within three attempts.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

interval_years.quote: The renewal shall be issued by the secretary upon payment of a biennial fee set by the board

required.quote: Physicians shall comply with all continuing professional development or continuing medical education requirements for renewal of a license issued by a member state.

available.quote: The Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners may, without examination, issue a license to any applicant holding a currently valid license or certificate issued to the applicant by the examining board of the District of Columbia, any state or territory of the United States, the National Board of Medical Examiners, the National Board of Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, or any province of Canada

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a currently valid license or certificate from another jurisdiction whose requirements at the time of issuance were not less than those of South Dakota. Board may require oral or written examination and personal appearance. Fee not to exceed $400.
requirements.quote: if the legal requirements of the examining board at the time it issued the license or certificate were not less than those of this state at the time the license is presented for registration

For the purposes of this subdivision, the patient is presumed incapable of giving free, full, and informed consent to sexual activity with the physician
